requirements.complete_dynamic_state: The strict target predicts complete sorted dynamic atoms and numeric fluents plus their canonical state identity; no state is truncated.
requirements.static_context_separation: Complete authoritative task context remains in the input and is checked through a separate immutable SHA-256 identity; static facts never enter predicted dynamic atoms.
requirements.trusted_verification: The verifier separately classifies schema, static context, source identity, action identity, applicability, state identity and exact authoritative effects.
requirements.raw_prediction_and_no_repair: Raw prediction text is retained. Rejected states are neither normalized nor applied, and trusted states are never substituted for incorrect predictions.
requirements.downstream_failure_separation: Local successor verification and downstream search status occupy separate fields; Goal 9 must report them separately.
requirements.independent_replay: A fresh authority registers each non-initial source through its complete retained producing-action path and recomputes verification from raw prediction without a model call.
requirements.shared_builder: The same successor_contract, projection and prediction_target builders define corpus labels and live model inputs; candidate target-state/evaluation fields are removed before projection.
requirements.training_only_membership: All 512 records come from the frozen 25-task BFS training order. The selection keeps 421 accepted original-membership transitions and fills 91 positions by fixed task-round-robin accepted-transition order.
requirements.complete_target_measurement: All 512 targets were measured with the pinned tokenizer before qualification: 124–383 tokens. The 512-token allowance is the 1.25-margin maximum rounded to 64, not the old 384-operation cap.
requirements.three_modality_freeze: Text, visual and multimodal share identical record IDs, actions and targets. Visual inputs use unlabelled 128px initial/current scenes with complete context and goal pages.
requirements.training_freeze: Each modality is fixed to 512 records, one epoch, seed 17, sequential no-shuffle sampling, global batch 32 and exactly 16 optimizer updates from its verified BFS adapter.
requirements.control_freeze: Evaluation compares model-generated and trusted successors under identical deterministic canonical BFS actions; invalid predictions never receive trusted replacement.
requirements.outcome_blind_coverage: Full 24-task coverage projects to 147.658902 GPU-hours and is infeasible. The preregistered minimum-exact-cost task per each of 12 domains plus all three development tasks projects to 62.333058/64 and was selected without model outcomes.
requirements.hardware_qualification: Both A100 workers completed full 512-token scalar, batch and repeated-batch generation for all modalities; repeated batches and scalar/batch first items were byte-identical.
requirements.discarded_training_probe: Every modality completed a finite discarded in-memory optimizer step over a full successor example; all 174,587,904 trainable adapter parameters were exercised and source checkpoints remained unchanged.
requirements.scheduler_and_budget: Workers used distinct ports 18800 and 18801. All successor attempts, including failures, consumed 0.22095979399151272 GPU-hours against the unchanged 64-hour cap.
requirements.no_scientific_execution: Qualification retained only unscored capacity outputs, made zero collection decisions and performed zero persistent training updates. Goals 8 and 9 own scientific execution.

targets.allowance_rule: ceil(measured maximum x 1.25) to the next 64-token boundary

retained_technical_failures.cause: Visual projections contain page-role text parts in addition to the JSON semantic part; the projector was corrected to replace exactly the JSON payload while retaining every page part.
The shared scheduler assigns the first free explicit MASTER_PORT and ignores a job-level preferred port; validation was aligned with the frozen scheduler pool before any model loaded.
